sprint: Example Lifecycle, Backlog Backfill, and Reviewer Feedback Loop Hardening
phase: Phase 5 — Reviewer feedback loop gap analysis

questions.question: What reviewer interface exists today?
questions.answer: CLI subprocess to example-reviewer repo. Command: python -m src.cli.main --json --safe-workspace compile-verify --family {family}. Located in src/plugin_examples/verifier_bridge/bridge.py.

questions.question: Does reviewer return per-example structured feedback?
questions.answer: NO. ReviewerResult contains: available (bool), passed (bool), error (str|None), details (dict|None). The details field is raw stdout (JSON-parsed if valid, else truncated string). No per-example findings.

questions.question: Does it return only ReviewerResult(passed=bool)?
questions.answer: Effectively YES. The passed field is the only actionable signal. details captures raw output but it is never parsed for per-example errors.

questions.question: Where is reviewer called?
questions.answer: Stage 16 of 17: _stage_reviewer() in runner.py:884-932. Runs after validation, before publishing.

questions.question: Can reviewer output be mapped to scenario_id/example_name?
questions.answer: NOT CURRENTLY. The reviewer runs against the entire workspace, not per-example. Output is not tagged with scenario IDs.

questions.question: Can reviewer feedback be fed into repair prompt today?
questions.answer: NO. The build-repair loop (runner.py:680-726) feeds compiler errors to LLM. The runtime-repair loop (runner.py:728-787) feeds runtime errors. There is no reviewer-repair loop.

questions.question: What schema change is needed?
questions.answer: ReviewerResult.details needs structured findings: list of {scenario_id, severity, category, file, line_or_symbol, message, recommendation}. The bridge must parse reviewer JSON output into this schema.

questions.question: What changes are required in the generator to use reviewer feedback?
questions.answer: 1. Add reviewer-repair loop in runner.py after _stage_reviewer(). 2. Extract per-example findings from ReviewerResult.details. 3. Feed findings into LLM repair prompt (similar to build-repair). 4. Update lifecycle record with reviewer_repair_attempts. 5. Re-run reviewer after repair.

required_changes.change: Add structured findings field with per-example severity/file/message
Parse reviewer JSON output into structured findings
Add reviewer-repair loop (similar to build-repair) after _stage_reviewer
Include reviewer findings in backlog_root_cause when reviewer fails

taskcard.title: Implement structured reviewer feedback extraction and reviewer-driven repair loop
acceptance_criteria: Reviewer returns per-example structured findings (severity, file, line_or_symbol, message)
Generator repair prompt can consume reviewer findings
Backlog records reviewer feedback detail if still failing
